products.name: Magick Box
products.blurb: AI creative platform on iOS, Android and the web
highlights: Built and run the Python 3.12 / FastAPI backend that serves every client: around 250 REST endpoints across 21 feature packages on a 58-collection MongoDB model, with a ranked social feed, Redis caching and sliding-window rate limiting.
Exposed every generation type through magick_ai with credit-based model tiers, so a new model or provider ships as configuration rather than backend code.

Moved long-running generation onto Celery workers with retries, exponential backoff and time limits, so a provider outage fails one job instead of the API; FFmpeg stitches podcasts and converts video.
Built Mini Cinema, a multi-shot AI film pipeline that streams reasoning, approval gates and finished renders to the client as typed content blocks.

Built real-time chat and group chat over Socket.IO with token streaming, AI personas alongside human members, @mentions and per-user unread counts, with pub/sub keeping conversations in sync across pods.

Built billing on Stripe Checkout, RevenueCat and AdMob rewarded ads with signature-verified webhooks and an idempotent credit ledger, so retried or duplicated webhooks never grant credits twice and subscriptions reconcile automatically.

Implemented device-bound JWT sessions with refresh rotation, Argon2 hashing with transparent migration of legacy hashes, email OTP and Google and Apple sign-in, so existing users kept their accounts through the change.

Deployed to Kubernetes on AWS with Helm, Istio mTLS and horizontal autoscaling from one multi-stage Docker image serving web and worker; GitHub Actions runs 181 pytest tests, build, release and DAST scanning on every change.

products.name: magick_ai
products.blurb: Multi-service AI SDK the Magick Box backend depends on (private repository, access on request)
highlights: Wrote and maintain the Python SDK: one UniversalAgent call covers chat, image, video, music and podcast generation across OpenAI, Google Gemini, Imagen and Veo, Stability, Replicate (Flux, Kling, MiniMax), Suno and AIML, with LLM calls routed through LiteLLM. Around 280 modules, shipped as 35+ tagged releases from 0.1 to 2.1.

Built the agents on top of it: chat orchestration with per-type handlers, validators and processors, a persona agent (Magick Friend), podcast and storybook generators, and automatic tagging for content discovery.

Added document analysis so chat can read user uploads (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and answer from their contents, plus web search, prompt enhancement and history compression tools, standardised result entities and one error model in place of seven provider-specific ones. Media lands in S3 with metadata in MongoDB.

products.name: Legal document RAG
products.blurb: Two retrieval prototypes over Thai statutes, Aug – Oct 2024 (private repositories)
highlights: Built policyGraphRAG, a question-answering API over eleven Thai statutes (Copyright, Patent, Trademark, Immigration, Labour Protection, Land Code, Revenue Code and others): set up the Microsoft GraphRAG pipeline per act with GPT-4o entity extraction, community summaries and LanceDB embeddings, served from FastAPI with one endpoint per act. Started the repo and built the indexing; a team of four added contract analysis on top.

Built vision-rag, a multimodal RAG chatbot that indexes PDF pages as images with ColPali through Byaldi, retrieves the top pages per query and answers with GPT-4o vision, so scanned statutes and tables work without OCR. Per-session indexes and uploads behind a FastAPI API.

products.name: Magick Whisper
products.blurb: Dog-training companion for the Guardian collar, on TestFlight
highlights: Took the product from an empty repository to TestFlight in seven weeks: a Go API (Gin, pgx, PostgreSQL) with embedded migrations, and a Flutter app built with Riverpod and go_router.
Implemented Google and Apple sign-in verified against cached JWKS, with 15-minute access tokens and rotating hashed refresh tokens, kept optional so onboarding passes App Store guideline 5.1.1.
Added on-device speech recognition with Whisper and Silero VAD in a background isolate, plus an offline session store with retry-safe UUIDv7 uploads, so training sessions record without a connection.
Go tests run against a real PostgreSQL service in CI and the build fails if any database test skips; Codemagic ships signed iOS and Android builds to TestFlight and Google Play.

products.name: Internal compliance tooling
products.blurb: Self-service compliance data tooling for the bank's legal team
highlights: Replaced the compliance team's manual data requests, where consumer records arrived from the core banking team as Excel exports, with a self-service web app in Angular and Spring Boot that lets them query the data on demand.
Designed the relational schema and SQL behind the reporting datasets, with indexed queries and paginated exports so large customer tables load and export without timing out.
Built the Java REST APIs and an audit trail recording who viewed which record, replacing untracked spreadsheet copies with a reviewable workflow.
